response.sql: WITH behavior_transactions AS (SELECT DISTINCT translink FROM advancedbehavior), mixes_and_counts AS (SELECT tr.ordertypedist as mix, COUNT(*) as count FROM transactionrecord tr WHERE tr.transreg IN (SELECT translink FROM behavior_transactions) GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as num_mixes, SUM(count) as total_count FROM mixes_and_counts) SELECT mac.mix, mac.count, CAST(mac.count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share, (CAST(mac.count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count) - (1.0 / t.num_mixes) as above_average FROM mixes_and_counts mac CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE CAST(mac.count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count > 1.0 / t.num_mixes ORDER BY share DESC
